text_block_list.text:
The trial of Бива Хаяхидэ's new
equation
focused on winning—rather
than simply not
losing—proves to be a
success, and she claims
victory at the
Kikuka Sho.

Бива Хаяхидэ is too happy to hide her
joy, and
when Нарита Таисин comes to
challenge her to a
rematch, she is
shocked by her friend's
unexpected
exuberance.

They promise to run together again at
the spring
Tenno Sho, and Biwa
Hayahide pronounces her
certain victory
with a huge smile.
